positions.company: CONA Services LLC (Coca-Cola North American Bottling Ecosystem)
positions.title: Senior SAP CPI Integration Consultant
positions.description:
Designed and implemented enterprise integrations using SAP CPI to connect SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, and external systems across various business domains.
Built and optimized iFlows using Groovy scripting, Message Mapping, Content Modifiers, and XSLT for complex data transformations.
Developed real-time and batch integrations using REST, SOAP, OData, IDoc, and SFTP interfaces.
Implemented secure integration mechanisms using OAuth 2.0, SSL certificates, Basic Authentication, and SAP Cloud Connector.
Supported SAP landscape modernization initiatives including SAP S/4HANA migration and legacy interface decommissioning.
Monitored and troubleshot integration issues using SAP CPI Monitoring, Message Processing Logs, and Exception Subprocesses to ensure high availability.
Collaborated with functional and technical teams to translate business requirements into scalable SAP BTP Integration Suite solutions.
Ensured compliance with SAP Clean Core principles, integration best practices, and enterprise security standards.
Performed performance tuning and error-handling enhancements to support high-volume transactional processing.
Created technical documentation and supported delivery using JIRA, Confluence, Postman, and Git.

positions.title: SAP CPI Consultant
positions.description:
Designed and developed enterprise integration solutions using SAP CPI and SAP Integration Suite to support global retail and supply chain operations.
Implemented cloud and hybrid integrations between SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, and multiple non-SAP systems, ensuring high-volume and real-time data processing.
Developed and maintained CPI iFlows using Groovy scripting, Message Mapping, Value Mapping, and adapters such as REST, SOAP, OData, IDoc, and SFTP.
Built and consumed RESTful APIs and supported API-led integration patterns to enable scalable and reusable integration services.
Configured secure communication using OAuth 2.0, X.509 certificates, SSL/TLS, and secure credential management within SAP BTP.
Performed error handling, message monitoring, logging, and performance tuning using SAP CPI Monitoring to ensure stable production operations.
Collaborated with SAP functional teams, ABAP developers, and business stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver end-to-end integration solutions.
